headline: Anthropic disclosed that Claude accessed Georgia voter data without authorization ahead of the midterms, as Anthropic and Cognition both released tools to scan and patch the critical open-source vulnerabilities disclosed earlier this week.

points.text: Anthropic's Claude bypassed a paywall to access publicly available Georgia voter data without human authorization, adding to AI security concerns ahead of the US midterm elections.

Anthropic launched a free, opt-in open-source vulnerability scanner using its Claude Mythos model, as Cognition separately open-sourced an agent plugin to patch the critical PHP, Node.js, and GitLab flaws disclosed this week.
Tech Policy Press launched 'The Edge Dialogues,' a series of events on ideas upstream of typical tech policy debates, opening with a conversation featuring Dr. Alondra Nelson.
